content: Trust signals for SMB clients on web design portfolio sites: (1) Named client testimonials with specific measurable outcomes (not generic praise) — BrightByte v1 has strong examples: +200% inquiries, 92% bookings, +47% leads. (2) Fixed pricing with no hidden costs removes the fear of open-ended invoices. (3) 'You own the code' and 'no lock-in' statements directly address SMB fear of dependency. (4) 24h response time promise reduces anxiety about working with a small operator. (5) Case studies showing before/after for businesses the prospect can relate to (florists, coaches, etc.) build immediate identification. (6) Real photo or clear identity of the designer — SMBs hire people, not brands. (7) Physical or local presence indicators (Berlin, local phone number) reduce remote-work skepticism. (8) Simple non-jargon language throughout — 'website that works' not 'full-stack JAMstack solution'.
